The [[meknek]] [[Fillik]] owned a '''PIP droid''' during the [[High Republic Era]]. Manufactured by [[Pui-ui Implement Products]], it was eighteen [[centimeter]]s (seven inches) tall, had [[Color|black]] and orange plating, and was equipped with an internal carousel that included custom tools. Fillik did not coddle his [[PIP droid]], unlike his colleague [[Verosha Aniseya]], who was unusually tender toward her PIP droid, [[Pip]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> Fillik carried his [[droid]] in a side-slung pocket while working on board the [[Trade Federation]] [[WD-2550 Whydah-class Yield Conveyer|WD-2550 ''Whydah''-class yield conveyer]] ''[[Fallon]]''.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> He transferred it to a [[holster]] on his [[Environment suit|EVA suit]] when tasked with making repairs to the [[starship]]'s [[Deflector shield generator|shield generator]] on the vessel's exterior while in [[Realspace|space]]. He removed the droid from the holster during repairs, holding it up to the generator before returning it to the holster.<ref name="Lost Found">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Fillik's PIP droid appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="Lost Found" /> the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 4]], [[2024]] on [[Disney+]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The scenes on the ''Fallon'' were shot at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Fantha Part I">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref>
